title: Normalized native realization of the coefficient Weil heart
statement: Fix a purity finite field and coefficient setting P [def-pur-conventions, def-weil-finite-field-fiber] and a separated finite-type arithmetic scheme X_0 over Spec(P.field.k_0). Use the actual common-stage coefficient Weil heart [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex, def-weil-constructible-heart] and its signed standard cohomology functors [def-sf-canonical-coefficient-weil-cohomology]. Fix a compactification c_0 of the structure morphism and an exceptional adjunction system S [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], and assume ringChar(k_0) differs from ell. There is an equivalence functor E from this coefficient Weil heart to native WeilSheaf(k_0,ell,X_0) [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework]. For every native exceptional right adjoint J to structure lower shriek and every integer n, native H^n(J(constant_point[0])) is isomorphic to E applied to coefficient H^n(exceptionalConstant(P,X_0,c_0,S)) [lem-sf-native-coefficient-cohomology-comparison]. For every natural d, E sends the unshifted coefficient commonWeilSheaf of twist d [def-weil-frobenius-coefficient-twists] to the native Tate sheaf of twist d tensor the native constant sheaf. There is no shifted Tate cohomology assertion.

proof.text: Restrict the normalized exact ordinary realization to the standard heart, transport the coefficient and geometric closures and section-module presentation, and lift the Frobenius comparison to fixed pairs. Ordinary full faithfulness transports structures and intertwining maps, giving an equivalence of Weil hearts.

Realize the exceptional counit with the counit-normalized compact-support comparison, transpose its equivariance, and use scalar Frobenius counit normalization to identify the action with the inverse-exchange mate. Exact cohomology gives the exceptional comparison for this heart realization. Uniqueness of right adjoints treats every supplied adjunction.

Realize the completed root tower, rationalize and extend scalars. Its cyclotomic action is the native Tate action. Tensor/unit normalization gives the native constant tensor factor. This involves only unshifted lines in the heart.

theorem native_coefficient_heart_comparison
    (c₀ : Compactification X₀.hom)
    (S : systems P.field P.coefficients.l P.coefficients.different P.coefficients.Qbar X₀)
    [Fact (ringChar P.field.k₀ ≠ P.coefficients.l)] :
    ∃ E : sfCommonStageWeilSheaf P.field P.coefficients.l P.coefficients.different
        X₀ P.coefficients.Qbar ⥤ WeilSheaf P.field.k₀ P.coefficients.l X₀.left,
      E.IsEquivalence ∧
      (∀ (J : WeilComplex P.field.k₀ P.coefficients.l (Spec (.of P.field.k₀)) ⥤
          WeilComplex P.field.k₀ P.coefficients.l X₀.left)
        (adj : WeilComplex.derivedLowerShriek P.field.k₀ P.coefficients.l X₀.hom ⊣ J)
        (n : ℤ),
        Nonempty ((WeilComplex.homologySheaf n).obj
            (J.obj (WeilSheaf.toComplex.obj
              (WeilSheaf.adicConstant P.field.k₀ P.coefficients.l
                (Spec (.of P.field.k₀))))) ≅
          E.obj ((canonicalCoefficientWeilCohomology P X₀ n).obj
              (exceptionalConstant P X₀ c₀ S)))) ∧
      (∀ d : ℕ, Nonempty (E.obj
          (FrobeniusCoefficientTwists.commonWeilSheaf P.field P.coefficients.l
            P.coefficients.different X₀ P.coefficients.Qbar (d : ℤ)) ≅
        (WeilSheaf.tateTwistSheaf P.field.k₀ P.coefficients.l X₀.left d).tensorObj
          (WeilSheaf.adicConstant P.field.k₀ P.coefficients.l X₀.left)
          (WeilSheaf.isLisse_tateTwistSheaf P.field.k₀ P.coefficients.l X₀.left d)))
